reason_for_check: Check endpoint radial-distribution definition against projective reparameterization; do not assume affine-time sphere or new-metric distance statements.
actual_original_definition: At each q≠p, D^p_q is kernel of w→h_q(gamma_q_prime(1),w). Only endpoint velocity line matters.
own_rechecked_argument: For h1=e^t h0 and projectively equivalent connections, gamma1_prime(1)=c(p,q)gamma0_prime(1) with smooth positive c. Hence h1(gamma1_prime(1),.)=e^t c(p,q)dE_p. Its kernel is exactly ker(dE_p), so direction-dependent reparameterization preserves the required integrable distribution. No assertion about h1-distance spheres or constant-affine-time initial-unit spheres is needed.
